```json
 "rationale": "The NMOS pair suits VCM=0.9 V with pfet Vth~1 V. Two stages with long-L loads give about 75 dB. Cc=1 pF and gm1~190 uS put GBW near 30 MHz. A 30 uA tail into 1 pF gives about 30 V/us slew. I6~120 uA (gm6 > 6*gm1) pushes p2 out for PM>61; Rz>1/gm6 places the zero in the LHP. The PMOS mirror feeding the PMOS CS stage tracks VDD for good PSRR. Total current is about 160 uA."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # input pair
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (30e-6, 16e-6, 60e-6),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror + 2nd stage (shared gm/Id, L for zero sys. offset)
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),
    "I6":    (120e-6, 70e-6, 250e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.5, 0.8, 2.0),        # NMOS current sources
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.3, 0.8, 2.5),        # Rz = rz_k / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmidn = 10.0

    # input pair (source ~0.2 V, body effect)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    # PMOS mirror load and 2nd-stage device: same gm/Id and L
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS current sources mirrored from ibias diode
    mr = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinp drives M1 whose drain is the mirror (diode) side -> the output inverts twice -> non-inverting
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)))
    # LHP zero from Rz > 1/gm6
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * (Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm))
    fz = wz / (2 * PI)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    k = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 16 * k / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(th) * 3.0   # allowance for flicker at 1 kHz
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "power": power}
```
